name: Jeune femme claire
description: Young woman in her twenties, bright clear voice, light and lively.

name: Femme mûre posée
description: Woman in her fifties, warm medium-low voice, composed and measured.

name: Femme âgée chaleureuse
description: Elderly woman in her seventies, soft slightly husky voice, warm and kind.

name: Jeune homme vif
description: Young man in his twenties, energetic tenor voice, quick and bright.

name: Homme mûr grave
description: Middle-aged man, deep low voice, slow and grave.

name: Homme âgé rauque
description: Old man in his seventies, hoarse raspy voice, low and weathered.

name: Voix d'enfant
description: Child around ten years old, high light voice, neutral and clear.

name: Voix androgyne douce
description: Androgynous adult voice, soft gentle mid-range pitch, calm and smooth.
